title: ui tests: the console project's `import.meta.env.VITE_APP_VERSION` define leaks into every project's `process.env`, so `buildIdentity-12970`'s "reads null" case goes red in full ui runs
body:
Filed by domain:spec seat 2 (account zhuangjianguo, session_01RyMY3prh9GRva1Tt37Di3i) from a merge-queue triage. Not a claim.

## Finding

Merge-queue build [40325012039](https://github.com/objectstack-ai/objectstack/actions/runs/40325012039) (queue entry for #26019, a `ui/packages/types` change) went red on `Test UI (16/16)` with:

```
FAIL  unit  packages/app-shell/src/__tests__/buildIdentity-12970.test.ts > resolveConsoleBuild: the console build identity (objectui#12970) > reads null under this test setup, which bakes no VITE_APP_VERSION
AssertionError: expected '1bbb7bf490' to be null
```

`1bbb7bf490` is the queue build's own `HEAD`. Nothing in `.github/workflows/` sets `VITE_APP_VERSION`. The value comes from the console's Vite config:

- `ui/apps/console/vite.config.ts:593` computes `consoleBuild = process.env.VITE_APP_VERSION?.trim() || readGitShortSha()`, and `:743` adds `define['import.meta.env.VITE_APP_VERSION']`.
- `ui/vitest.config.mts` lists `apps/console/vitest.config.ts` as a project, and that file merges the console `vite.config.ts`.
- Vitest moves every `import.meta.env.*` define into the **main process's** `process.env` while it resolves a project's config (`ui/node_modules/vitest/dist/chunks/cli-api.*.js`: `if (key.startsWith("import.meta.env.")) { process.env[envKey] = replacement; ... }`).

So once the `console` project's config has resolved, the `unit` project's workers can inherit `VITE_APP_VERSION`, and `getConsoleBuild()` returns the git sha instead of `null`. The case at `buildIdentity-12970.test.ts:40` asserts on the test process's environment, not on product behaviour. It passed in the earlier queue builds, so whether a worker sees the leaked value depends on timing and shard layout. That makes it a latent flake, not a regression of the PR it hit.

The PR still merged (merge commit `1bbb7bf4908f634a5b3164305062d117d4b8b4fe`), so the next PR whose full ui run draws the same layout can hit the same red.

## Done when

`buildIdentity-12970.test.ts` stays green under a full `pnpm --dir ui run test` that includes the `console` project. One way: the "reads null" case controls its own env (for example `vi.stubEnv('VITE_APP_VERSION', '')` with `vi.unstubAllEnvs()` in `afterEach`), or the console config stops baking a git sha under `process.env.VITEST`. A control should show the case fails when `VITE_APP_VERSION` is exported in the shell before the run, and passes after the fix.
